description:
Fast local disk space visualization for Windows with cushion treemaps.

AtlayaView scans one or more drives and turns used storage into an instantly readable treemap, making large folders and files visible at a glance. It is a local-first Windows desktop application with an optional native Rust renderer and automatic fallback to the managed renderer.
Version 2.0.36 switches AtlayaView from a WinGet portable package to a real Inno Setup installer, registering under Apps and Features with its own Start Menu entry and Program Files folder.
